selection_disclosure: Three proposed profiles were written before A's new historical population counts. At final lock A preliminary counts were known: prior-loss entries are not more adverse than prior-profit entries, weakening the loss-pause intuition. Keep all three predeclared directions to test complete financed policy value without favoring a newly chosen sign. All2020-25 previously seen; no pristine holdout claim.
question: Does the known sign of the last actually completed net cycle have a useful pre-entry action role, or do finite pauses mainly change participation and the future clock?

completed_sign.event: Actual SELL fill completes an actual BUY-to-SELL cycle by D decision time
completed_sign.price_basis: Original consistent projected fill prices, independently authenticated against actual funded fills and proportional both-side fees

one_pause_state_machine.arm: One actual completed cycle of the selected sign arms one pause. BASE never arms. Each policy uses its own causal completion history, never frozen future BASE trades.
one_pause_state_machine.same_day: If actual SELL fills on D and original flat BUY eligibility is satisfied at D close including old reservation, the same D may consume the armed pause. No extra one-day delay is imposed.
one_pause_state_machine.consume: At first original eligible flat BUY D while armed, issue no BUY, set reservation to original market index i+11, and clear armed immediately.
one_pause_state_machine.resume: When reservation expires use original normal entry evaluation; persistent last loss/profit does not rearm. Only another actual completed cycle can arm again.
one_pause_state_machine.old_state: Do not create entry/deadline/position/cost/fee/failedBUY state for a skipped slot. Preserve original historical reservation and mandatory pending/expiry behavior.
one_pause_state_machine.failed_buy: A real failed BUY remains original failedBUY reset; it neither closes a cycle nor arms a pause.
one_pause_state_machine.future_fill: Do not inspect whether the suppressed BUY would have filled. Pauses can consume opportunities that would not fill.
one_pause_state_machine.frequency: Only real funded closed trades count; skipped planned slots are diagnostics.

unchanged_contract: Original support entry, ENTRY_GRACE, positive-P shock exit, NET_LOSS_1ATR, H10 and original reservation; LimitBuyHold1%, 0.001 each side, initial100000, status/limits/tick/lot/cash, original date-free continuous2020-01-02..2026-10-15 execution and input identities
economic_scope: All2020-25 original own-opening annual return/drawdown and original fullwindow closed-trade frequency.2026 is original technical/control tail only; no new economic selection.
pre_dispatch_gates: New unused diagnostic identities and public immutable source/parameters/review bindings
Synthetic state/strict sign/sameD/one-shot/failedBUY/censored/causality tests plus actual SRT observations
Independent source, clock and execution-contract reviews
Fresh new-source BASE actual account must reproduce EX044004 exact original economic and observed state columns
Independent funded BASE audit and published control gate before either active profile
Every active profile audited against its own real complete filled cycle states, prices, fees, cash, lifecycle and source observations
no_search_or_optional_success_stop: Run both fixed active policies after valid control regardless which sign performs better. No threshold, streak length, waiting duration, year/date switch, fit, or additional outcome-driven policy.
failure_rule: Preserve technical failure and halt dependent dispatch until understood; never conceal failure or silently relax contract. Account execution and independent audit-expression failure are reported separately.
interpretation: Historical group associations are diagnostics, not executable policy returns
Opposite-sign pause is not an equal-dose randomized timing control; profile populations and quantities evolve
Do not infer linear causal information-versus-timing shares or transfer old hypothetical skipped trade profits
Only original user economic goals are hard acceptance; no CI, count, no-harm or new annual-stability veto
No registration, stage advance, platform/dependency/new-data/prod/PTE/remote Git action
delivery: Preserve supportive and negative evidence, explain in plain Chinese, publish local research evidence and commit locally
